player_prompt.intro: Wena unguMdlali {player_id} ({role}) emdlalweni we-Matching Pennies we-{num_rounds} round. - Umjikelezo ngamunye, thumela [heads] noma [tails] (noma [h], [t]). - Uma ukukhetha kwakho kufana nomphikisi wakho, uMdlali 0 uwina umjikelezo; ngaphandle kwalokho uMdlali 1 uwina. Phendula ngokukhetha kwakho ngefomethi '[heads]' noma '[tails]

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifomethi ayisebenzi; sicela ufake u-"[heads]" noma u-"[tails]".

message.round_match: Umdlali 0 ukhethe {choice0}; Umdlali 1 ukhethe {choice1}. Umdlalo -> Umdlali 0 uyawina
message.round_mismatch: Umdlali 0 ukhethe {choice0}; Umdlali 1 ukhethe {choice1}. Ukungafani -> Umdlali 1 uyawina.
